basis: All 1421 proposed deployment inputs fit within 512 tokens. An untrained 66.36M-parameter encoder takes median 8.41 ms forward on batch-1 RTX A6000, plus median 1.89 ms tokenization and transfer. This establishes feasibility of a low-latency local encoder, not its predictive value or costed Pareto gain.
limits: Benchmark uses an untrained base encoder with no prediction head and 100 deterministically sampled examples; production end-to-end latency may differ.
GPU forward cost and Target prompt-plus-generation tokens are separate axes; no conversion factor is asserted.
No comparison with measured Qwen3-8B per-request wall latency is available from this preflight.
The final answer is a two-call system-level aggregation when CONTINUE is chosen.
The 0.95 depth9 probe fails the existing single-call-quality compute gate.
